text: In 2023, a ship drilled into rock from deep inside the Earth.
The hole was one thousand two hundred and sixty-eight metres deep, and mostly rock changed by seawater.
That's more than six times further than the deepest hole into sea-floor mantle rock before it.
But the Kola hole is about ten times deeper.
Under continents, the mantle starts, on average, about forty kilometres down.
So how did a much shorter hole get to rock from below the crust?
The trick isn't digging deeper. The full video shows where they dug.
